limits: The 214-slot model assumes this truncated reception carries the same body as the independently received p145/p211 sources; matching headers and long literal overlaps support the relation.
The four maps enumerate only the origins of the two identical duplicated five-groups in this stated frame; they do not exhaust all historical corruption mechanisms.
The 84 copied frame coordinates are not direct recovery from p187 and are unassigned in its 33-position primary total.
The full source-linked candidate retains the literal reference B848727 and the unfinished final clause; it does not assert compliance with the key instruction.
